newsitem.title: ITALY: Prodi says happy with lira's progress.
newsitem.headline: Prodi says happy with lira's progress.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi said on Wednesday he was happy with the lira's strong recent showing.
Asked by reporters at a construction industry congress if he was happy with the way the lira was going he said: "Of course".
The Italian currency has risen strongly against the mark in recent weeks. It was at about 972.85/973.15 lire to the mark on Wednesday morning. -- Rome newsroom +396-678-2501
